findings.detail: The summary says 30 days after kickoff but the task list says five weeks.
findings.quote: Everything in the table has to be done five weeks after kickoff, by the morning of the run.

findings.title: Insurance and approval wait on each other
findings.detail: The table says approval waits for insurance; the notes say insurance waits for approval.
findings.quote: Kerry will take out the event insurance once the council has approved the course, because the insurers want a copy of the approved course map before they will cover us.
